Name: Slingshot Plus
Author: scotteh101
Description:
Started as a project to bring back pre-1.4.1 slingshot mechanics (explosive ammo radius & pricing) but, ended up adding a few other things on top of it.

Config options can been seen in images

[b]v2.3.2-[/b][b]v2.3.3[/b][b] — Working more on i18n[/b]

[b]v2.3.1 — Added i18n[/b]
[list]
[*]Added localization: Spanish, German, French, Chinese[/*]
[/list][b]v2.3 — Added i18n[/b]
[list]
[*]Added i18n for localization upon user request[/*]
[/list]
[b]v2.2.2 — Infinity damage fix #2[/b]
[list]
[*]The Infinity Slingshot was ignoring Combat Perks for damage, which caused difference in damage between a Galaxy Slingshot (with combat perks) and an Infinity Slingshot (ignoring combat perks) to be less than intended. Issue has been resolved.[/*]
[/list][b]v2.2.1 — Infinity damage fix[/b]
[list]
[*]The Infinity Slingshot was secretly hitting like a basic slingshot. It now packs the punch it was always meant to — comfortably the hardest-hitting slingshot around.[/*]
[/list][b]v2.2:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added forge upgrade path: Galaxy Slingshot > Infinity Slingshot[/*]
[*]Added gem enchanting via the forge for both the Galaxy and Infinity Slingshots with the following modifiers
[list]
[*]Ruby: +10% damage per level[/*]
[*]Aquamarine: +15% crit chance per level[/*]
[*]Emerald: +10% projectile speed and draw speed per level[/*]
[*]Jade: +25% crit power per level[/*]
[*]Amethyst: +10% ammo replenishment chance per level[/*]
[*]Topaz: +1 defense per level[/*]
[*]Diamond: Fills remaining enchants with random picks[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Gem enchantments display as stat lines in the item tooltip, matching the melee weapon format[/*]
[*]Gem enchantments carry over when upgrading a Galaxy Slingshot to Infinity via the forge[/*]
[*]Ammo is preserved through forge upgrades[/*]
[*]Added GMCM toggle for the forge upgrade path (Upgradeable via Forge)[/*]
[*]Fixed missing Infinity Sprite in assets[/*]
[*]Enemy damage multiplier now applies to all slingshot projectiles, not just explosive ammo. Moved it to its own section in GMCM.[/*]
[*]Added Infinite Ammo option (all ammo types — previously explosive ammo only). Moved it to its own section in GMCM.[/*]
[/list]
[b]v2.1[/b]:
Changed Pre 1.4.1 Explosive Ammo Pricing to an adjustable value based on user input
[list]
[*]Added Infinity Slingshot to Adventure Guild Shop (Default 200k)[/*]
[*]Infinity Slingshot features:
[list]
[*]Custom Sprite[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]50% damage increase over Galaxy Slingshot[/*]
[*]+1 Radius modifier on Explosive Ammo[/*]
[*]50% chance to not consume ammo[/*]
[*]Increased Projectile Speed and Draw Speed[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
SMAPI (required)
Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, but highly recommended)

Manifest.Name: Slingshot Plus
Manifest.Description: Enhances slingshot gameplay: configurable explosion radius, damage scaling, player damage reduction, infinite ammo, legacy ammo pricing, and the Galaxy Slingshot at Marlon's shop.
Manifest.Author: scotteh101
